{
 "name": "Ogre",
 "description": "Ogre code the 2008-06 exe links statically (Roblox's Ogre forks such as RbxSceneManager/RbxEntity, and header templates); OgreMain itself is rgmain.dll. No upstream layer: only exact mined ogre-* sources, swapped in by swap_build.py (verified layer).",
 "layers": [],
 "test": "ogre_link",
 "verified": true,
 "test_includes": [
  "rebuild/2008-06/out/Ogre/force"
 ],
 "import_dlls": [
  "rgmain.dll"
 ],
 "force_verified": true,
 "extra_libs": [
  "msvcprt.lib"
 ],
 "extra_libs_note": "The exe imports the std::string operator templates from msvcp90.dll; the 1.4.5 OgreMain objects carry /DEFAULTLIB only for MSVCRT and OLDNAMES."
}
